summary: A school board brings back only part of the laid-off teachers and pays for it with a higher tax levy.
realLife: After parents marched for the return of nearly three hundred laid-off staff, mostly teachers, a school board with a deficit of about six million dollars and an unclear set of books voted to raise the levy by about a hundred fifty dollars per home. It brought back more than eighty-six teachers at once and about a hundred in June, fewer than the parents wanted. A state audit was under way.
sources: ABC7 New York (Bayonne, New Jersey), 'Bayonne BOE votes to restore some laid off teachers, but raise property taxes', date not shown on the page: https://abc7ny.com/post/bayonne-boe-votes-to-restore-some-laid-off-teachers-but-raise-property-taxes/1970099/
